mechanism: Topiramate may increase dronedarone levels via CYP3A4 inhibition and competition for renal clearance, while dronedarone may increase topiramate clearance, creating bidirectional interaction potential with additive cardiac and CNS effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, QTc interval, and topiramate levels; assess for increased CNS adverse effects; dose adjustment of either agent may be needed based on clinical response and tolerability.
